unitTitle: Nutrition, Movement, Sleep, and Performance Without Diet Culture
title: Guided practice: sleep and circadian habits
essentialQuestion: How can understanding nutrition, movement, sleep, and performance without diet culture help us explain, decide, create, or solve something that matters?

keyPoints: The circadian system helps time sleep and wakefulness, while sleep pressure builds during waking hours; regular timing, morning light, and a wind-down routine support both processes.
